title: Customers
description: The shop's customers, their contact details and identity papers.
search: Search by name, phone or national ID
emptyHint: Add a customer to sell on installments or to keep their details for next time.
blockHint: A blocked customer can't buy on installments. The reason is kept in the audit log.
